import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    accounts = inputs["accounts"]
    txns = inputs["txns"]

    valid_accounts = set(accounts["account_id"].tolist())

    # opening balances per account (if duplicate account_id rows exist, take the last one
    # as a reasonable default since spec doesn't define duplicates explicitly)
    opening_balance_map = {}
    for _, row in accounts.iterrows():
        opening_balance_map[row["account_id"]] = row["opening_balance"]

    # filter txns to known accounts only
    filtered = txns[txns["account_id"].isin(valid_accounts)].copy()

    # sort by account_id, txn_ts, txn_id to process per account in order
    filtered = filtered.sort_values(by=["account_id", "txn_ts", "txn_id"], kind="mergesort")

    ledger_rows = []
    fee_rows = []

    current_account = None
    bal = 0.0
    fee_dates_charged = set()

    for row in filtered.itertuples(index=False):
        acc_id = row.account_id
        txn_id = row.txn_id
        txn_ts = row.txn_ts
        amount = row.amount

        if acc_id != current_account:
            current_account = acc_id
            bal = opening_balance_map[acc_id]
            fee_dates_charged = set()

        bal = bal + amount

        if amount < 0 and bal < 0:
            txn_date = pd.Timestamp(txn_ts).date()
            if txn_date not in fee_dates_charged:
                bal = bal - 35.00
                fee_dates_charged.add(txn_date)
                fee_rows.append({
                    "account_id": acc_id,
                    "fee_date": txn_date,
                    "trigger_txn_id": txn_id
                })

        ledger_rows.append({
            "txn_id": txn_id,
            "balance_after": bal
        })

    txn_ledger = pd.DataFrame(ledger_rows, columns=["txn_id", "balance_after"])
    if len(txn_ledger) > 0:
        txn_ledger["txn_id"] = txn_ledger["txn_id"].astype("int64")
        txn_ledger["balance_after"] = txn_ledger["balance_after"].astype("float64")
    else:
        txn_ledger = pd.DataFrame({"txn_id": pd.Series(dtype="int64"),
                                     "balance_after": pd.Series(dtype="float64")})

    fees = pd.DataFrame(fee_rows, columns=["account_id", "fee_date", "trigger_txn_id"])
    if len(fees) > 0:
        fees["account_id"] = fees["account_id"].astype("int64")
        fees["fee_date"] = pd.to_datetime(fees["fee_date"])
        fees["trigger_txn_id"] = fees["trigger_txn_id"].astype("int64")
    else:
        fees = pd.DataFrame({"account_id": pd.Series(dtype="int64"),
                               "fee_date": pd.Series(dtype="datetime64[ns]"),
                               "trigger_txn_id": pd.Series(dtype="int64")})

    return {
        "txn_ledger": txn_ledger,
        "fees": fees
    }
